basis: The chart title is 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category'. The percentage inscriptions above each marker are the explicit quantitative values for feedback share: Service Quality 52%, Service Cost 51%, Service Design 12%, Support Access 17%, Service Delivery 42%, and Other 41%. The smallest printed percentage is 12%, which corresponds to Service Design. Therefore, Service Design is the lowest-share feedback category and should be routed to the low-feedback coverage follow-up workflow. (Note: The vertical axis positions of the markers are inconsistent with the percentage labels; the explicit percentage labels are the authoritative values for 'share'.)
option_label: Route Service Design to low-feedback coverage follow-up
